detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Mechanisms in Auditory Processing
detail.summary: Our research into predictive dynamics within music cognition has progressed through the synthesis of interoceptive inference models and the ASAP hypothesis. The study establishes that music perception is not merely passive reception but an active, predictive simulation of temporal structures. We have consolidated these findings into a notebook that clarifies how these mechanisms modulate emotional response and rhythmic anticipation. Future research will explore the limits of these predictive simulations and their cross-modal applicability.
